# app_template v1.0.0

First release: a reusable C++ backend + React frontend starting
point, so a new app doesn't require re-doing this scaffolding
every time.

## Backend

- CMake build (`backend/CMakeLists.txt`), out-of-source, C++23.
- `backend/external/` for vendored dependencies as git
  submodules — `init-nested-submodules.sh` handles cloning
  submodules-of-submodules a host's own automatic submodule init
  doesn't recurse into.
- `backend/data/` tracked (via `.gitkeep`) for runtime data,
  gitignored otherwise.
- Placeholder `include/sample.h` / `src/main.cpp` showing the
  expected structure.

## Frontend

- Vite + React + TypeScript, scaffolded via `npm create vite@latest`.
- ESLint configured out of the box (`frontend/eslint.config.js`).

## Tooling

- `.clang-format` / `.clang-tidy` at repo root, with documented
  reasoning for each disabled check.
- Root `.gitignore` covering backend build artifacts (including
  explicit guards against an accidental in-source build), frontend
  `node_modules`/build output, Doxygen output, and common IDE/OS
  files.
- `Dockerfile` — multi-stage `ubuntu:24.04` build for the backend,
  parameterized via `BINARY_NAME` so a forked app only needs to
  update one place.
- Doxygen config (`docs/Doxyfile`) generating API docs from
  `backend/include` and `backend/src`.
- MIT `LICENSE`.

## CI

- **Build** — Linux, GCC + Clang, Debug + Release.
- **Clang Format** / **Clang Tidy** — static analysis and
  formatting checks on `backend/include` and `backend/src`.
- **Sanitizers** — ASan+UBSan and TSan jobs; boot-only smoke tests
  out of the box, with `TODO`s marking where to add real
  endpoint checks once the app has real handlers.
- **Frontend** — lint + build for `frontend/`.
- **Docs** — Doxygen → GitHub Pages.
- **Release** — this workflow, publishing `.github/releases/<tag>.md`
  as the GitHub Release body on any `v*` tag push.
- **Dependabot** — weekly updates for GitHub Actions and
  `frontend/` npm dependencies.

## Known limitations

- No test suite for the backend yet — `backend/` has no `tests/`
  directory. Add one before relying on `build.yml` for anything
  beyond "it compiles."
- Sanitizer CI jobs only verify the binary boots cleanly; they
  don't yet exercise any real request/response or concurrency
  path, since none exists in the placeholder backend.
- No deployment config included (no Render/Vercel/Fly-specific
  files) — deployment is expected to be app-specific, decided
  per project built from this template.
